{{Quote|The witness claims the droid insulted his heritage and legitimacy before setting off an explosion which destroyed the entire factory.|Part of MI-726's bounty posting describes the attack on the factory|<ref name="BTDF" />}}
A '''factory''' was controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during its reign and was protected by at least one [[Unidentified security guard|security guard]]. The building was [[Attack on an Imperial factory|attacked]] by the rogue [[MI-series security droid]], [[MI-726]], who insulted the [[Security guard/Legends|security guard]] and then set off an explosion which destroyed the entire [[Factory/Legends|factory]]. The guard survived and gave a statement on the attack which was then used in a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] posting on 726. The bounty posting was created due to the destruction of the factory and several other Imperial targets.<ref name="BTDF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The factory was first mentioned in "[[Bounties to Die For]]," an article in the [[Star Wars Gamer 6|sixth]] issue of [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine series. The magazines were supplements for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' and the factory was included as part of an entry on MI-726 written by [[S. Mitch Ritchie]].<ref name="BTDF" />
